steps: Copy examples/plugins/chat_example to the isolated instance plugins directory.
Restart the demo server to rediscover manually copied files.
Settings → Plugins → Installed → Chat panel (example) → Enable.
Close Settings, send Say hello in one sentence. Do not use tools. through the actual plugin iframe composer.
Wait for the actual response and capture the working view.
privacy_review: Only synthetic conversation and local example. No credentials, account identifiers, or personal paths.
